newsitem.title: USA: MCI filing approved for Texas service.
newsitem.headline: MCI filing approved for Texas service.

text.p: MCI Communications Corp said on Thursday the Texas Public Utility Commission approved the company's application to provide local telephone service.
The approval will lead to competition between MCI and SBC Communications Inc's Southwestern Bell, MCI said.

The ruling specifically eliminated the so-called "build out" requirement by Texas state law, which could have forced MCI and other larger companies to duplicate Southwestern Bell's network as a precondition for competition.
MCI said it has not resolved negotiations with Southwestern Bell for MCI to start service.
The companies have to resolve operational support systems issues that will allow competing networks to connect with one another, MCI said.
Other issues include allowing necessary access to telephone numbers, installing circuits for directory assistance, 911 services and interconnection, MCI said.
